caption: The drawing depicts a set of infant clothing items, illustrated in black ink lines with light beige and pinkish watercolor shading. At the center is a long, flowing gown with a gathered waist, scalloped edges, short ruffled sleeves, and a delicate floral and cornucopia embroidery pattern along the hem and chest area. The gown is worn by a faceless infant figure, who also wears a bonnet with a floral embroidered border and lace trim. To the upper left, there is a small, long-sleeved jacket with scalloped lace along the hem and cuff, tied at the neck. Above and to the right of the central figure is an additional bonnet, shown from the side, similarly decorated with a floral pattern and lace trim, with ribbons hanging down. At the lower left corner, there is a single small mitten or glove with a lacelike border at the wrist and tiny embroidered details. In the bottom right corner, another bonnet is shown, this time with an embroidered motif on the side and a scalloped edge, colored with pinkish shading inside. The background of the drawing is an off-white color, and the entire composition is arranged with the larger central figure surrounded by the smaller individual clothing articles.
title: Baby Costume
